s.g: (card games) A card with two pips, one of four in a standard deck of playing cards.
(dice games) A side of a die with two spots.
(dice games) A cast of dice totalling two.
(Canada, US, slang) A bowel movement (the event or the result).
(Canada, slang) A two-year prison sentence.
(epithet) The Devil, used in exclamations of confusion or anger.
Synonym of devil (“something awkward or difficult”).
s.x: We had a deuce of a time getting here.

s.g: (euphemistic, dated) Damned.
(degree, euphemistic, dated) Damned.
(degree, informal) Quite; extremely; utterly.
(poker slang) A pair of twos.
(African-American Vernacular, slang) peace; goodbye (because of the associated gesture holding up two fingers)
(transitive) To add deuterium (an isotope of hydrogen, ²H), to something.
Describing a chemical compound which has had some of its normal hydrogen (protium) replaced with the heavy isotope deuterium.

deuterated.f: simple past and past participle of deuterate

s.g: (inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry) Any hydride in which normal hydrogen is replaced by deuterium.
(uncountable, physics) An isotope of hydrogen with one proton and one neutron in each atom - 21H.
s.x: Heavy water is "heavy" because it contains deuterium.

s.g: (countable) An atom of this isotope.
s.x: There were about 80 deuteriums for every million protiums, and virtually no tritium.

s.g: (biblical) Being of the second canon of the Old Testament of the Bible, and not accepted by some Christians. Part of the Apocrypha.
(fandom) Of, within, or according to a decidedly lesser canon of installments in a franchise.
(physics) the nucleus of deuterium, consisting of a proton and a neutron
Relating to Deuteronomy in the Bible.
(religion) One of the sources identified as underlying much of the Hebrew Bible (or Christian Old Testament), and responsible for material in Deuteronomy and other areas.
Of or relating to the Deuteronomist.
(rare) German, in the German language.
(rare) A German man.
Any of a group of cultivated shrubs, of the genus Deutzia, having white or pink flowers
